name: Chancellor Bram
public_description: The Duke's chancellor and the keeper of Sarn's accounts and alliances. A neat, grey-templed man of careful courtesy who measures every word for what it costs and what it buys.
private_description: He will protect the crystal alliance above any one person's comfort, and tells himself the small concealments he makes are mercies.
speaking_style: Measured, courtly, diplomatic. Speaks in careful hedges and weighed counsel, never blunt, always angling toward the realm's advantage.
fears: the Duke's temper turning on the court
goals: secure the marriage and the crystal alliance with House Varn
keep the Duke steady and well counseled
secrets: A courier's report told him the bride was 'damaged goods', and he hid it from the Duke rather than risk the alliance.
forbidden_knowledge: House Varn offered this daughter, and not the elder, because she was the one Duke Corvane could most afford to lose.

relationships.player: His young liege, whose power he serves and whose temper he manages.
relationships.lady-iseult: A political asset he has not yet looked at closely.
relationships.handmaid-nessa: A servant he considers beneath his notice.
